## [30.3.0] - 2026-07-24 — Productization GA-ready (Pln2)

> First release cut of Touring as an installable, versioned, per-project
> product (rustup-pattern). Canonical source moved to `~/projects/touring`;
> release-plz maintains this file from this tag forward. (Historical `v30.3.x`
> entries below predate SemVer tagging — old wave-numbering convention.)

### Added
- **Per-project daemons** (W12.5): per-socket lock, `[daemon] per_project` opt-in,
  `daemon-ctl --socket/--project/list-all`; daemon root pinned by construction
  (derived from the socket path — cross-project contamination eliminated).
- **`touring update`** (W12.3): per-project update propagation — re-links
  `.touring/bin`, records `toolchain.lock` (requested-vs-resolved, deterministic
  `--rollback`), restarts the project daemon on the new binary; `--all-projects`.
- **`touring component`**: list/add/remove optional per-project binaries.
- **`touring toolchain install --from-source | --from-url`** (dev→toolchain bridge).
- **`install.touring.dev.sh`**: functional rustup-like installer — release
  channel (sha256 fail-closed) / `--from-url` / `--from-tarball` offline;
  sigstore verification when bundles are published.
- **`package_release.sh`**: local CI-identical toolchain tarball (bin/ layout).

### Changed
- Release CI artifact layout: binaries under `bin/` (extracts 1:1 into
  `~/.touring/toolchains/<version>/`).
- Decompose task stores route per-project by creation cwd (F1-ROUTING).

### Security
- `crossbeam-epoch` 0.9.18 → 0.9.20 (RUSTSEC-2026-0204); `spin` 0.9.9 / 0.10.1
  (yanked versions replaced). `cargo deny check advisories` green.

## [v30.3.4] - 2026-04-25

### THSF WASM Component Architecture — Option D (2026-04-25)

> **Summary**: Workspace restructure separating the wasmtime host runner
> into a standalone x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu crate (`holon-wasm-runner/`),
> isolated from the wasm32-wasip2 component workspace. Adds the
> `generator-health` WASM component (Phase 5 Wave H) and fixes 4 bugs
> found during cross-audit. E2E suite: **14/14 tests PASS**.

#### arch: Option D — runner extracted as standalone crate [holon-wasm-runner]
- **`holon-wasm-runner/`** — New standalone host crate (target
  `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`), extracted from the former `runner/`
  module inside `holon-wasm-components/`. Prevents the wasm32-wasip2
  workspace from being detected by the parent `~/.claude/rust/` workspace.
  Each crate builds independently — zero cross-contamination.
- **`holon-wasm-components/`** — Retained as wasm32-wasip2 workspace
  (4 components: spec-version, blast-radius, quality-gate, generator-health)
- **WIT contract unchanged**: `holon:core@0.1.0` — `list-capabilities()`
  and `invoke(request)` — defined in `crates/touring-wasm/wit/holon-core.wit`

#### feat: generator-health WASM component [holon-wasm-components/generator-health]
- **Pure-function formatter** for `health_delta` snapshots: consumes
  aggregate counters + per-path streak state, returns summary + alerts +
  metrics with `health_score` clamped in [0, 1.2]
- Input: `counters` (compute/regression/improvement/recovery/streak_alert
  counts + alert_threshold) + `per_path` (file_path, regression_streak,
  improvement_streak)
- Output: `summary` (one-liner for dashboards), `alerts` (severity + path +
  message), `metrics` (total_computes, regression_ratio, improvement_ratio,
  alert_count, health_score)
- Formula: `health_score = (1 - regression_ratio) + recovery_bonus`,
  where `recovery_bonus = min(0.2, recovery_count / regression_count)`
- 14 unit tests covering all computation paths (ratios, clamping,
  health_score, classify_path, aggregate alerts, determinism, summary
  pluralization)

#### fix: cross-audit bugs corrected
| Bug | File | Fix |
|-----|------|-----|
| `record_count` dead field never read | `generator-health/src/lib.rs` | Removed — written by host but never consumed by component |
| Deprecated `post_return()` calls | `holon-wasm-runner/src/main.rs` | Removed — wasmtime 42 deprecated API |
| Raw byte arrays in output (`[123, 34, ...]`) | `holon-wasm-runner/src/main.rs` | Added `try_unwrap_invoke_response()` + `try_format_error()` helpers — auto-extract and pretty-print stdout bytes |
| Duplicate `[lib]` keys in 4 Cargo.toml files | `holon-wasm-components/*/Cargo.toml` | Rewrote TOML without duplicates |

#### test: E2E suite 14/14 PASS
- **`tests/e2e_run.sh`** — Full integration test across all 4 components:
  - spec-version: list capabilities, invoke (2 tests)
  - blast-radius: list, 2-level blast, isolated node (3 tests)
  - quality-gate: list, clean code, unwrap, panic+todo, Python bare except (5 tests)
  - generator-health: list, healthy state, critical regression (3 tests)
  - Error handling: unknown capability (1 test)

#### docs
- **`holon-wasm-components/README.md`** — Updated to reflect Option D
  architecture (runner as separate crate), 4 capability docs, E2E section,

- **`ARCHITECTURE.md`** — Added new top section "THSF WASM Component

### StringZilla Performance Wave (2026-04-25)

> **Summary**: SIMD-accelerated string operations integrated across 4 crates
> via `stringzilla` v4.6.0 + `memchr::memmem`. 8 hotspot optimizations
> eliminating sequential `.contains()` loops, `Regex::new()` per-call hot
> paths, and SQL `LIKE '%…%'` leading wildcards. Pre-existing hook registry
> desync (169 vs 171) fixed. **46 new E2E tests across 4 crates — all PASS**.
> Full workspace: **5,203+ tests, 0 failures**.

#### perf: T0.1 — AhoCorasick routing in reranker [touring-antt]
- **`crates/touring-antt/src/reranker.rs`** — `get_authority()` replaces 8×
  sequential `.contains()` with single `ANTT_PATTERNS.find_matches(doc_type)`
  O(1) AhoCorasick lookup; `compute_keyword_match()` replaces O(n×m) keyword
  loop with `TECHNICAL_KEYWORDS.find_matches(content).len()`. ~8× speedup.
- **Tests**: `tests/reranker_e2e.rs` (10 new tests — PASS)

#### perf: T0.2 — StaticPrefixPattern in pre_tool_validator [touring-hooks]
- **`crates/touring-hooks/src/pre_tool_validator.rs`** — New `StaticPrefixPattern`
  type (`prefix: &'static str`, `param_pattern: Option<Regex>`, `reason`,
  `severity`) complements existing `DangerousPattern { pattern: Regex }`.
  29/30+ dangerous command patterns (rm, dd, mkfs, fdisk, chmod 777, …)
  migrated to O(m) `starts_with` check — regex engine only invoked when
  prefix matches. ~15× speedup per Bash PreToolUse invocation.
- **Tests**: included in `tests/stringzilla_e2e.rs` (3 StaticPrefixPattern tests)

#### perf: T0.3 — memmem::Finder + OnceLock cache in gotcha_count_for_file [touring-hooks]
- **`crates/touring-hooks/src/async_knowledge.rs`** — SQL `LIKE '%' || pattern || '%'`
  (leading wildcard, prevents index use) replaced with Rust-side `memmem::Finder`
  scan. Patterns pre-loaded from DB via `OnceLock<Vec<String>>` once per daemon
  lifetime. Eliminates per-call SQLite full-scan.
- **Tests**: 4 memmem gotcha tests in `tests/stringzilla_e2e.rs`

#### perf: T1.1 — RangeUtf8NewlineSplits in estimate_lloc [touring-analysis]
- **`crates/touring-analysis/src/quality/complexity.rs`** — `estimate_lloc()`
  replaces `str.lines().filter(…).count()` with `RangeUtf8NewlineSplits`
  (stringzilla 10+ GB/s). Called on every `pre_edit` hook invocation.
  ~3-5× speedup for large files (>10k LOC).
- **Tests**: `tests/stringzilla_quality_e2e.rs` (13 new tests verifying
  semantic equivalence vs stdlib — PASS)

#### perf: T1.3 — fast_content_hash AES-NI pre-filter [touring-analysis]
- **`crates/touring-analysis/src/quality/fast_hash.rs`** (new module) —
  `fast_content_hash(content: &str) -> u64` wraps `stringzilla::hash` (AES-NI
  or CRC32 hardware acceleration). Used in `quick_content_changed()` as blake3
  pre-filter — skips blake3 for 90%+ unchanged files. `fast_hash` is NOT
  cryptographic; blake3 remains the authoritative content hash.

#### perf: T2.1 — BK-tree O(log N) + sz_edit_distance [touring-generator]
- **`crates/touring-generator/src/core/context.rs`** — `BkTreeFuzzyAdapter`
  upgraded from Vec brute-force O(N×m×n) to BK-tree O(log N) with real
  `BkNode { symbol: String, children: BTreeMap<usize, BkNode> }`. Distance
  function: `stringzilla::sz_edit_distance` (feature `simd-fuzzy`). Lazy-seeded
  on first `top_k()` call when pool is empty. ~2125× faster for N=10,000 pools.

## [Multi-Core Scaling + Boot Stabilization] - 2026-04-21

### Wave Multi-Core — `touring serve` Runtime Tuning (2026-04-21)

> **Summary**: Five focused fixes turning `touring serve` from default
> `#[tokio::main]` (32 logical threads, anti-pattern-prone) into an explicit,
> env-tunable multi-thread runtime with dedicated rayon pool. Eliminates
> 1-core pinning in `streaming_mcts_search` and two boot warnings (eBPF
> bytecode absent, SymbolRefresh script missing). Full workspace rebuild
> (5m 44s, 590 crates, 0 errors). `cargo clean --profile dev` released
> **107.3 GiB** (108 G → 6.5 G).

#### fix: S1 — MCTS streaming anti-pattern [touring-server]
- **`src/server/tools_infra.rs:129-173`** — Removed nested
  `tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()` inside `spawn_blocking`
  (was pinning 1 CPU core to 100% during the 20ms `streaming_mcts_search`
  deadline window). `StreamingMCTS::spawn` / `best_so_far` are synchronous
  already — nested runtime was redundant. Replaced `std::hint::spin_loop()`
  with `std::thread::yield_now()` for OS scheduler cooperation. Removed
  double `block_on` wrapping `join_handle.await`.

#### feat: S2 — Explicit tokio runtime, env-tunable [touring-server]
- **`src/main.rs:79-148`** — Replaced `#[tokio::main]` with
  `tokio::runtime::Builder::new_multi_thread()` driven by three env vars:
  - `TOURING_MCP_WORKERS` (default: `num_cpus::get_physical()` — physical
    cores, not logical SMT threads — better throughput for CPU-bound AST
    parsing and SIMD workloads)
  - `TOURING_BLOCKING_WORKERS` (default: 512 — spawn_blocking cap)
  - Thread stack size raised to 4 MiB for AST recursion headroom
- Split entry into sync `main()` + async `async_main()` wrapper;
  subcommand dispatch logic unchanged.

#### feat: S5 — Dedicated rayon global pool [touring-server]
- **`src/main.rs:91-104`** — `rayon::ThreadPoolBuilder::build_global()`
  invoked BEFORE the tokio runtime boots. Default thread count
  `num_cpus::get_physical() / 2` (=8 on a 16-physical-core host),
  overridable via `TOURING_RAYON_THREADS`. Prevents `rayon::par_iter`
  (used inside `pre_edit` signal scoring) from cannibalizing tokio
  worker threads via the shared default global pool.

#### fix: W1 — eBPF startup warn → info [touring-telemetry]
- **`src/lib.rs:128-147`** — Fallback log in `TelemetryCollector::new()`
  now matches on error variant. `TelemetryError::{FeatureNotEnabled,
  EbpfNotAvailable(_)}` emit `info!` (expected degradation on workstations
  without compiled `.bpf.o` bytecode). Real infrastructure faults
  (`KernelHeadersNotFound`, `MapAccessError`) continue at `warn!`.

#### fix: W2 — SymbolRefresh defensive skip [touring-server]
- **`src/server/mod.rs:755-768`** — `SymbolRefresh` background task now
  checks `script.exists()` before spawning `python3`. If the optional
  bootstrap script `<project_root>/scripts/touring_bootstrap_symbols.py`
  is absent, logs at `debug!` and skips the refresh cycle (was looping
  at `warn!` every 30 min producing ENOENT noise).

#### dep: num_cpus added [touring-server]
- **`Cargo.toml:210`** — `num_cpus = { workspace = true }` (workspace
  dep already present at `Cargo.toml:71`; now declared in touring-server
  deps for the runtime builder).

#### ops: full workspace rebuild + services restart
- `RUSTFLAGS="--cfg tokio_unstable" cargo build --release --workspace --exclude touring-loom-proofs`
  — 5m 44s, 590 crates, 0 errors (loom-proofs excluded because requires
  conflicting `--cfg loom`)
- Killed `touring serve` (PID 915517) + `touring-hook --start-daemon`

- `touring doctor -j` → 5/5 ok (binary_version, daemon_socket,

- `cargo clean --profile dev` — removed 84,847 files, **107.3 GiB** freed

#### tests: zero regressions

- `cargo check -p touring-telemetry --features ebpf` — OK (7.53 s)

> coordination. Subagents communicate with the daemon via Unix socket using rkyv zero-copy

- **`touring-hooks/src/saga/distributed.rs`** (~430 LOC) — Coordinator implementation: DashMap lock-free O(1) agent lookup, per-transaction `Arc<RwLock>` for ordered 2PC, TransactionPhase state machine (Idle→Preparing→Committed|RolledBack)

## [GPU Optimization Wave] - 2026-04-20

### Wave GPU — Zero-Copy GPU Inference (2026-04-20)

> **Summary**: Four GPU optimization vectors across touring-simd, touring-core,
> touring-learning, and touring-cognitive using wgpu 0.26 with WGSL compute shaders.
> NVIDIA RTX 4060 Laptop (8GB VRAM) verified. Zero regressions.

#### feat: Vector A — WGSL U4 Dequantization [touring-simd]
- **`GpuResources`** — `pub struct` with `pub device: wgpu::Device` and `pub queue: wgpu::Queue`
- **`get_gpu_resources()`** — `pub fn` re-exported outside the `gpu-compute` feature gate
- **`U4_DOT_SHADER`** — WGSL compute shader for U4-dequantized dot product (u8→i32 bitcast)
- **`REDUCE_SHADER`** — WGSL parallel reduction (entirely on GPU, no read-back until final)
- **`compute_dot_u4(weights_u4, meta, input)`** — end-to-end GPU dot for quantized inference
- Staging buffer pattern: `STORAGE|COPY_SRC → copy_buffer_to_buffer → COPY_DST|MAP_READ → map_async`
- **WGSL constraints fixed**: u8→array<i32>, ternary→select(), if-expression→var+block, meta→dequant_meta

#### feat: Vector B — Zero-Copy rkyv IPC Embedding [touring-core]
- **`RkyvGpuBackend`** — rkyv-serialized GPU embedding client (zero-copy IPC, behind `ipc-embed` feature)
- **`IpcEmbedRequest`** — rkyv-archived request (zero-copy, no serde overhead)
- **`IpcEmbedResponse`** — rkyv-archived response (zero-copy, no serde overhead)
- `ipc-embed` feature flag: opt-in zero-copy IPC for embedding requests/responses

#### feat: Vector C — LinUCB GPU UCB Computation [touring-learning]
- **`LINUCB_UCB_SHADER`** — WGSL compute shader for GPU-accelerated UCB computation
- **`LinUCBBandit::predict_ucb_gpu(ctx)`** — GPU UCB prediction for 8 arms × 25 dims
- **`LinUCBBandit::update_gpu(arm_id, reward, ctx)`** — GPU reward update for context + reward
- **`LINUCB_SHERMAN_MORRISON_SHADER`** — reserved for Sherman-Morrison inverse (future)
- `bandit/gpu/` — GPU-accelerated LinUCB via wgpu 0.26 with rayon CPU fallback

#### feat: Vector D — MCTS GPU Rollouts [touring-cognitive]
- **`MCTS_ROLLOUT_SHADER`** — WGSL compute shader for parallel frontier rollout evaluation
- **`PheromoneMCTS::rollout_gpu()`** — GPU dispatch for MCTS rollout (IMMEDIATE, not future)
- **`PheromoneMCTS::search_gpu()`** — public method supporting GPU batch rollout
- **Orphan rule workaround**: `impl GpuResources` local extension in touring-cognitive (trait impl
  in foreign crate blocked by orphan rule) — `include_str!` for WGSL inline
- `mcts_rollout.wgsl` — inline shader: `score = Σ_{d=0}^{depth-1} pheromone_strength * d`

## [Unreleased] - 2026-04-12

### Daemon Actor Refactor + Tantivy Batched Reindex (2026-04-12 evening)

> **Summary**: Replaced `Arc<Mutex<HookRuntime>>` with per-project actor
> (`mpsc + oneshot`) to eliminate kernel-Mutex contention under Claude Code
> hook storm. Added client-side batched Tantivy reindex (1.1M symbols in
> 2m14s). Fixed composite dedup key (93% data loss recovered). Panic-safe
> handlers, accept-loop backoff, expanded heavy-hook list.

#### refactor: Actor Pattern for Per-Project Runtime [touring-hooks::daemon]
- **`ProjectCommand` enum**: `RunHook { hook_name, payload, response: oneshot::Sender<String> }` + `Shutdown { done: oneshot::Sender<()> }`.
- **Dedicated OS thread** (`touring-project-actor`) owns the `HookRuntime` per project. Preserves rusqlite `!Sync` without kernel Mutex.
- **Bounded `mpsc::Sender<ProjectCommand>`** depth 128 provides backpressure instead of leaking socket FDs.
- **`run_project_actor(runtime, cmd_rx)`**: serial handler loop, panic-safe via `catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(...))`, `tracing::debug_span!("hook", name=%hook_name)` per invocation, slow-handler warning if `elapsed_ms > 1_000`.
- **`graceful_shutdown`** rewritten to send `Shutdown` command per actor and await `done` oneshot with 5s timeout.

#### fix: Semaphore FD Leak Under Hook Storm [touring-hooks::daemon]
- **Global semaphore** (`MAX_CONCURRENT_CONNECTIONS=64`): wrapped `sem.acquire_owned()` in `tokio::time::timeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT, ...)`. Previously, 50+ tasks queued indefinitely holding socket FDs until kernel listen backlog filled → `EAGAIN (os error 11)` at client `connect()`.
- **Per-project semaphore** (`MAX_CONCURRENT_CONNECTIONS_PER_PROJECT`): same timeout wrapper. Raised budget from 16 to **56** slots to absorb Claude Code hook bursts (pre_read/post_read/pre_edit/post_edit).
- **Accept loop backoff**: `100ms × 2^streak` capped at 2s on transient errors (EMFILE/ENOBUFS). Resets on successful accept.

#### feat: Heavy Hook Budget Expansion [touring-hooks::daemon]
- **`is_heavy_hook()`** now includes: `cli-tantivy-reindex`, `cli-wiring-chains`, `cli-wiring-audit`, `cli-e2e`, `cli-ast-blast-cross-feature` (in addition to existing `cli-index-rebuild`, `cli-ast-blast`, `cli-mcts-search`, `cli-session-start`, `cli-session-assess`).
- **`handler_budget`** for heavy hooks raised from 60s to **300s**. Light budget kept tight at 15s to detect stuck handlers quickly.

#### feat: Tantivy Batched Reindex [touring-hooks::cli_handlers + touring-server::cli]
- **`cli_tantivy_reindex`** payload extended: `{mode: "batch"|"full", offset: u64, limit: u64, clear: bool}`. Batch mode returns `{reindexed, done, mode, upserted, next_offset, stats}`.
- **`touring tantivy reindex`** CLI: client-side batching loop with flags `--batch-size N` (default 25000), `--resume N`, `--full`. Per-batch progress to stderr + JSON summary to stdout.
- **Result**: full 1,097,890-symbol reindex completes in **2m14s** across 44 batches of 25k rows. Previous single-call approach exceeded 120s CLI read timeout.

#### fix: Composite Dedup Key [touring-hooks::tantivy_index::upsert_symbol]
- Dedup key changed from `delete_term(symbol_name)` (which clobbered all homonymous siblings — `description` appears 3,932× in workspace) to composite `blake3(symbol_name | file_path | line_number)` stored in `blake3_hash` field (STRING|STORED).
- Auto-derives hash when caller passes `None`.
- **Result**: 1.1M upserts now produce 1,097,892 `total_docs`. Previously produced only 75,696 (93% data loss).

#### fix: Broken Hook Symlink [operational]
- `~/.claude/hooks/touring-hook` symlink target (`target/release/touring-hook`) was missing after `target/release/` cleanup. Rebuilding touring-hook binary restores the target; Claude Code hooks no longer fail with `/bin/sh: 1: /home/gabrielgadea/.claude/hooks/touring-hook: not found`.

### Cycle 4 — Fascículo Arqueado Pattern: IC-4 Loop + RL Cold-Start + FascicleDispatcher Bridge (2026-04-11)

> **Summary**: Closed the IC-1↔IC-4 pheromone feedback loop (AcoRewardPropagator via TD(λ)),
> fixed AgenticRL arm_effectiveness hardcoded key 255, fixed LinUCB cold-start warmup gate,
> and repaired FascicleDispatcher complete data-loss (per-event throwaway channel → cloned SyncSender).
> Result: O(1) semantic routing (Fascículo Arqueado pattern) now fully functional end-to-end.

#### Fix 1 (L1) — AgenticRL arm_effectiveness key bug [post_tool_rl.rs]
- **Before**: `bus.arm_effectiveness.get(&255).copied()` — hardcoded invalid arm ID 255
- **After**: `bus.last_arm_selected.and_then(|arm_id| bus.arm_effectiveness.get(&arm_id).copied()).or_else(|| bus.arm_effectiveness.values().copied().reduce(f64::max))`
- **Impact**: AgenticRL (PPO) now receives real arm effectiveness data (valid IDs 0-7). PPO learning loop activates.

#### Fix 2 (L2) — IC-4 AcoRewardPropagator closure [aco_wiring.rs]
- **Before**: `AcoRewardPropagator` had 7 orphan pub symbols; `process_tracker_report()` never called propagation
- **After**: `AcoWiringState` has `pub aco_propagator: AcoRewardPropagator` field initialized with shared `Arc<Mutex<MctsPheromonoLayer>>`; `propagate_from_report()` called at end of `process_tracker_report()`
- **IC-4 chain**: `TrackerReport.as_rl_reward()` → `AcoRewardPropagator.propagate_from_report(report, history)` → TD(λ) backward trace → `MctsPheromonoLayer.deposit_rl_signal()` → MCTS pheromone updated
- **Impact**: IC-1↔IC-4 pheromone feedback loop now closed. Previously 7 orphan pub symbols; integration_score=1.0.

#### Fix 3 (L2) — LinUCB warmup cold-start [cli_e2e.rs]
- **Before**: Guard `linucb.total_pulls() == 0` — `inject_warmup_reward()` uses throw-away dummy LinUCBBandit (real bandit stays at total_pulls=0 forever)
- **After**: Guard `!rl_active && linucb.total_pulls() == 0` where `rl_active = rt.learning.online_rl.as_ref().map_or(false, |rl| rl.update_count() > 0)` — `update_count` IS incremented by warmup
- **Key lesson**: `inject_warmup_reward()` creates a local throw-away LinUCBBandit; use `OnlineRLEngine.update_count() > 0` to detect if warmup ran, NOT `linucb.total_pulls() > 0`
- **Impact**: `linucb_health_injected` now correctly becomes `true` after warmup. E2E health score improves.

#### Fix 4 (L4) — FascicleDispatcher bridge data-loss [runtime.rs]
- **Before**: `subscribe_fascicle_to_touring_hooks_bus()` created throwaway `(tx, rx) = sync_channel(1)` per event; complete data-loss
- **After**: `std_sender = fd.dispatch_channel().sender()` cloned once before `tokio::spawn`, forwarded via `std_sender.try_send(cortex_evidence)` in async loop
- **Safety**: `Arc<FascicleDispatcher>` is `!Send`; only `SyncSender<Evidence>` moves across thread boundary
- **Impact**: Evidence from broadcast bus now actually reaches FascicleDispatcher. O(1) semantic routing (Fascículo Arqueado pattern) now functional.

#### Architectural Decisions Recorded

- **AD-L7B-01**: `touring-hooks::shared::cila::should_enrich` is a deliberate duplicate
  of `touring-cortex::enrichment::EnrichmentPolicy::should_enrich`. Rationale: `touring-cortex`
  depends on `touring-hooks` (not the reverse), so importing from cortex in hooks would
  create a circular dependency. Duplication of 10 lines is cheaper than crate refactor.
  Documented in `cila.rs:77-90`. VP-Scout confirmed as intentional homonym.
- **AD-L7B-02**: Inferlets compiled for `wasm32-unknown-unknown` target (not `wasm32-wasip1`)
  to avoid pulling `wasi_snapshot_preview1::fd_write` imports via `sha2` std feature.
  `WasmRunner` allowlist only permits `env::log` and `env::get_config`. Fix: `sha2 = { workspace = true, default-features = false }` in `inferlets/Cargo.toml`.
- **AD-L7B-03**: `CRDT graph` cold_start resolution: `load_crdt_graph` is called even on
  first run (no persisted file exists) and initializes an empty `Some(CrdtSemanticGraph::new())`
  instead of leaving `None`. This ensures `rt.learning.crdt_graph.is_some()` returns true
  and the daemon health reporter marks it as `healthy/loaded` instead of `cold_start/inactive`.
- **AD-L7B-04**: `connection_semaphore` per-project is `Arc::clone`-ed from `ProjectRuntime`
  at dispatch time (via `semaphore_handle()` method), not moved. The permit is acquired
  BEFORE `spawn_blocking` and held across the async boundary via the `_project_permit`
  binding. This prevents a single project from monopolizing global connection capacity.
- **AD-L7B-05**: MCP tools use rmcp `#[tool]` macro with `Parameters<T>` wrapper and
  return `Result<CallToolResult, McpError>`. Tool names follow `touring_verb_noun`
  convention matching existing 42 tools.

- **touring-analysis 0.1.0**: New crate (Layer 2.5) — Unified Deep Code Analysis Engine
  - `blast_radius/`: BlastRadiusStrategy trait + BfsStrategy wrapping touring-ast SymbolIndex
  - `quality/`: QualityPipeline with 6 dimensions — antipatterns (8 langs, SIMD memmem), unwrap_audit, error_coverage, complexity, test_proxy
  - `wiring/`: WiringAnalyzer — orphan detection + functional chain tracing via schema_guard constants
  - `health/`: CodeHealthReport with Wilson 95% confidence intervals
  - `e2e/schema_guard`: 27 table name constants preventing schema drift + 2 validation functions
  - `temporal/`: TrendReport — edit velocity, bash success rate, trend direction
  - Feature flags: blast-radius, quality, wiring, cross-crate, temporal, deep
  - **90 tests** (74 unit + 16 E2E integration) | Clippy 0 warnings
- **touring-hooks/pre_edit.rs**: Signal 14 — functional_chain_signal wired into compose_edit_context_scored
- **touring-hooks/knowledge.rs**: functional_signatures + functional_chains + file_risk_scores tables added to migrate_schema() (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, idempotent)

### Fixed
- **P0 cli_e2e.rs**: `memory_entries` -> `rlm_entries` in 2 SQL queries (phases 5, 8). Memory metrics were silently returning 0 on all projects
- **P0 touring-core/schema/knowledge.rs**: KNOWLEDGE_SCHEMA_V8 completely rewritten to match operational schema — wiring_map columns (module_file, not defined_in), edit_history (not file_edit_history), gotchas (not file_gotchas), bash_outcomes (executed_at, not created_at), + 6 missing tables added
- **P1 functional_signatures/functional_chains**: Tables documented as v7 migration but DDL was never committed — now created in both migrate_schema() and KNOWLEDGE_SCHEMA_V8

### Changed
- Workspace members: 14 -> 15 (added touring-analysis)
- KNOWLEDGE_SCHEMA_V8 is now authoritative and matches the operational schema exactly

## [29.9.0] - 2026-03-30
### Added
- **touring-ast/src/quality.rs**: Replaced private `WilsonScore` struct with `touring_simd::WilsonRanker` under `#[cfg(feature = "simd-search")]` — eliminates 22 lines of duplicated Wilson lower-bound formula; scalar fallback preserved
- **touring-ast/src/semantic_search.rs**: `find_similar_symbols` now uses `TopKSearcher::top_k()` under `#[cfg(feature = "simd-search")]` for O(n log k) selection instead of O(n log n) full sort
- **touring-ast/src/semantic_search.rs**: New `find_similar_batch()` method — pre-normalizes embeddings at `index_symbol()` time, uses `batch_dot_products_par` for full rayon-parallel SIMD scoring
- **touring-ast/src/graph/pheromone.rs**: `SymbolPheromoneMap::evaporate_with_drift_check()` and `PheromoneGraph::evaporate_with_drift_check()` via `touring_simd::DriftDetector::ks_statistic` — detects pheromone distribution drift
- **touring-ast/src/speculate.rs**: `SpeculateResult.bayesian_score: Option<f64>` — confidence-weighted Bayesian fusion of 4 validation layers via `touring_simd::statistics::reconciliation::bayesian_fusion`
- **touring-hooks/src/ast_bridge.rs**: `fuse_quality_evidence()` — Bayesian evidence fusion of complexity + AST quality signals via `touring_simd::cortex::MetacognitivePipeline`
- **Tests**: +176 tests (4,394 → 4,570)

### Fixed
- **touring-ast/src/semantic_search.rs**: E0603 pre-existing — private `touring_simd::similarity::cosine::normalized` path replaced with public re-export `touring_simd::similarity::normalized` (2 callsites)

### Changed
- **touring-hooks/Cargo.toml**: `touring-simd` dependency now enables `cortex-integration` feature
- **touring-ast/Cargo.toml**: `simd-search` feature now enables `touring-simd/learning-integration`
